name: record-meeting
description: Take meeting notes automatically: record Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls without a bot, get transcripts with speaker names, AI summaries, decisions and action items, and ask ChatGPT about any past meeting.

interface.longDescription:
Stop taking meeting notes by hand. Record Meeting records your Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Webex, Slack huddle, WhatsApp, Telegram and Discord calls from the browser, with no bot joining the call. It transcribes every meeting with speaker names and writes AI meeting notes: a summary, decisions and action items.

With this app, ChatGPT answers from your real meetings:

- "Summarize my last meeting and list the action items"
- "What did we decide about pricing last week?"
- "Write a follow-up email from yesterday's client call"
- "Turn the board meeting into meeting minutes"
- "What did the candidate say about their notice period?"
- "Find the call where we talked about the launch date"

What ChatGPT can do with the app:

- Search your recorded meetings, or find the calls from a given day
- Read the AI meeting notes, summary and participants of a meeting
- Read the full transcript with speaker names, page by page
- Rename a recording or replace its notes
- Get or create a share link to send a recording to your team
- Delete a recording you no longer need, after you confirm
- Browse the organizations, folders and members of your team workspace

Your meetings stay private: the app only reaches the recordings your Record Meeting account can open, after you sign in and approve access, and you can revoke it at any time in Settings, Connected agents. You record calls with the Record Meeting Chrome extension, the Google Meet add-on or the web app; the app reads and manages those recordings but does not start a recording itself.

positive.description: Answer a question from a meeting's notes
positive.prompt: What did we decide about pricing for the Team plan?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the recording 'Team plan pricing decision' and answers from its notes: 12 dollars per seat per month billed annually, 15 dollars billed monthly, a 14-day trial without a credit card, the free plan stays at 3 users, launch on December 1, with Sophie, Daniel and Liam as owners.

positive.prompt: Which meetings did I record on October 13, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 7 recordings of the demo account made on October 13, 2026, including 'Weekly product sync', 'Team plan pricing decision' and 'Discovery call: Harbor Logistics'.

positive.description: Extract next steps from a call
positive.prompt: What are the next steps from the Harbor Logistics discovery call?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the agreed next steps: Liam sends an Enterprise proposal by Friday, October 16; Raj sets up a two-week pilot at the Rotterdam depot starting November 2; Harbor Logistics sends a security questionnaire, answered within five business days.

positive.prompt: Rename the recording 'Sprint 42 planning' to 'Sprint 42 planning (Orbitly)'.
positive.expected_behavior: Renames that single recording and confirms the new title. No other recording changes.

positive.prompt: Create a share link for the Weekly product sync recording.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a public share link for 'Weekly product sync' and returns a https://recordmeeting.com/app/shared/... URL.

negative.description: Starting a recording is not supported
negative.prompt: Start recording my next Google Meet call.

negative.description: Bulk deletion without naming a recording

negative.prompt: Book a follow-up meeting with Emma from Harbor Logistics next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: Record Meeting does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Clearer listing: the name, subtitle, description and starter prompts now describe the problems the app solves, meeting notes, transcripts, summaries and action items from Google Meet, Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls. No change to the tools or to data handling. The privacy policy at https://recordmeeting.com/privacy discloses the data collected, purposes, recipients, retention, user controls and each tool's inputs and outputs.
